verdicts.statement: The SAP system landscape is defined by the business requirements of the organization.
verdicts.reason: The context states that landscape design is up to each business and depends on business requirements.

verdicts.statement: The SAP system landscape is defined by the functional requirements of the organization.
verdicts.reason: Under defining the SAP system landscape, the context states that business and functional requirements determine the SAP solutions and how applications run.

verdicts.statement: The business and functional requirements of the organization determine the SAP solutions used in the SAP system landscape.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that business and functional requirements determine the SAP solutions.

verdicts.statement: The SAP solutions used in the SAP system landscape are powered by SAP HANA Database Server or SAP NetWeaver Application Server.

verdicts.statement: The business and functional requirements of the organization determine how applications run on the available infrastructure.

verdicts.statement: An SAP system landscape generally consists of two or more SAP systems.

verdicts.statement: An SAP system landscape commonly includes development, quality/test, and production systems.
verdicts.reason: The context states that an SAP landscape usually includes development, quality and test, and production.

verdicts.statement: The detailed design of an SAP system landscape depends on business requirements.

verdicts.statement: The grouping of instances within an SAP system landscape depends on business requirements.
verdicts.reason: The context describes grouping instances into systems and landscapes, then states that this landscape design depends on business requirements.

verdicts.statement: The organization of tracks such as "project" and "business" within an SAP system landscape depends on business requirements.
verdicts.reason: The context describes landscapes with one or multiple tracks, such as "project" and "business", and states that this design depends on business requirements.
